caption: Front cover of Art Kleps, The Boo Hoo Bible: The Neo-American Church Catechism (San Cristobal, N.M.: Toad Books, 1971).
alt: Psychedelic pop-art paperback cover: a jagged red-and-yellow explosion over a starry night sky, with the title THE BOO HOO BIBLE, a yellow BOO! burst, the price $5, the subtitle The Neo-American Church Catechism, With a Review by Timothy Leary, and the author's name ART KLEPS.
credit: Toad Books, 1971, via Open Library / Internet Archive (item boohoobibleneoam00klep)

note: The Internet Archive's own full scan of this book (identifier boohoobibleneoam00klep) is lending-restricted, so no interior page is used. This is the book's front cover only, at Open Library's 'large' cover size (317x475px), the best publicly reachable resolution found (Internet Archive's own item-tile thumbnail of the same cover is smaller, 180x277px). A cover thumbnail used solely to identify the volume is a narrow, low-risk fair-use case, distinct from reproducing any of its text. A prior agent searched Wikimedia Commons for Kleps portraits or Neo-American Church / Millbrook-estate photographs and found nothing properly licensed or correctly identified; this book-cover thumbnail was not considered in that earlier pass.
